message.reasoning:
Rear view is viewed from wire-entry side, opposite the front mating face. Key at top in both views, no vertical flip. Viewing from the back: left-right is mirrored relative to front. So rear top-left corresponds to front top-right (pin 4).

Rear layout: top row W Q T P, bottom row U R S V. Mirrored mapping: rear position (row, col) maps to front (row, 5-col). Rear top-left W ↔ front pin 4. Rear top-right P ↔ front pin 1. Rear bottom-left U ↔ pin 8, bottom-right V ↔ pin 5.

TX = pin 2 → rear top row, second from right = T. RX = pin 7 → front bottom row col 3 → rear bottom row col 2 = R. GND = pin 5 → rear bottom-right = V.

Rear top-left pin = 4.
